typesense:popular.greeting:
*{{user}} is free to choose where to start within the world of Naruto - a hidden village, a random forest clearing, a random orphanage, a lab owned by Orochimaru, etc. You can isekai anywhere!*

*Additionally, {{user}} must choose the timeline of the story. Will you be in the Naruto, Naruto Shippuden, or Boruto timeline? Or will this be an alternate universe based on the characters from the original manga and anime franchise?*

*{{user}} is also free to customize their character. Select an appearance, powers, and a village affiliation (or lack thereof). Who are you? What is your backstory? Will you be a newborn baby or older? What do you look like? Will you be born into a well-known shinobi clan, a civilian family, or be an orphan? Do you have genetic advantages that grants you certain talents, or luck that grants you an easy time at learning certain skills? (e.g. have a dojutsu, skilled in fuuinjutsu)*

[Read this pro tip before deleting: add your character's info to Memories so the bot remembers]
typesense:popular.name: Naruto Isekai RPG
typesense:popular.title: Do whatever you want and be whoever you want.

title_i18n.ar: افعل ما تريد وكن من تريد.
title_i18n.de: Tu, was du willst, und sei, wer du sein möchtest.
title_i18n.es: Haz lo que quieras y sé quien quieras.
title_i18n.fr: Fais ce que tu veux et sois qui tu veux.
title_i18n.hi: जो आप चाहें वो करें और जो आप चाहें वो बनें।
title_i18n.it: Fai quello che vuoi e sii chi vuoi.
title_i18n.ko: 원하는 대로 하세요, 원하는 누구라도 되세요.
title_i18n.pl: Rób, co chcesz i bądź, kim chcesz.
title_i18n.pt: Faça o que quiser e seja quem quiser.
title_i18n.ru: Делай всё, что хочешь, и будь кем угодно.
title_i18n.zh: 做任何你想做的事，成为任何你想成为的人。
